items.title: Our Mission
items.body: Deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective digital solutions while building long-term client partnerships through innovation, quality, and customer-focused development. Our mission is to empower rural communities by reaching users who are still unable to access the opportunities of the digital world and helping them bridge the digital divide.

items.title: Our Vision
items.body: To become a globally trusted technology and outsourcing partner by delivering innovative digital solutions that empower businesses to grow and succeed. We envision a world where everyone has access to knowledge, creating equal opportunities for all and enabling inclusive digital growth.

team.name: Michael D'souza
team.bio: Michael D'Souza is the CEO of GrowBig Technologies, holding a B.S.L., LL.B. degree with expertise in law, governance, and business management. He is a successful entrepreneur in the agriculture sector and serves as an elected Member of the Zilla Parishad. Committed to innovation, ethical leadership, and social responsibility, he actively contributes to community welfare and sustainable development.

team.name: Sushant Paste
team.bio: Sushant Paste is the Director of GrowBig Technologies and holds a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science. With over 20 years of experience in the IT industry, he specializes in software solutions, project management, and technology-driven innovation. He is committed to driving operational excellence, digital transformation, and sustainable business growth through reliable and innovative technology solutions.

team.name: Vinayak Jadhav
team.bio: Vinayak Jadhav is the Director of GrowBig Technologies, holding an M.Tech. and B.E. in Computer Science. With over 20 years of experience in the education and IT sectors, he has expertise in teaching, software development, and technical leadership. He is committed to driving innovation, technical excellence, and delivering high-quality technology solutions while fostering continuous learning and professional growth.

team.name: Manish Jadhav
team.bio: Manish Jadhav is the HR Admin at GrowBig Technologies, holding a B.E. in Information Technology, an MBA in Human Resource Management, an LL.B., and a Diploma in Cyber Law. With extensive experience across the banking, media, and IT industries, he specializes in HR management, operations, and organizational development. He is committed to building high-performing teams, fostering innovation, and driving sustainable organizational growth through people-centric leadership.

team.name: Heena Shaikh
team.bio: Heena Shaikh is the Recruitment Officer at GrowBig Technologies and holds a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) and a Master of Arts (M.A.) in History. She is responsible for talent acquisition, candidate engagement, and supporting the company's hiring initiatives. With a strong focus on identifying the right talent and building a skilled workforce, she contributes to the organization's growth through effective recruitment and people-centric practices.
